integrity: Every all-length assertion is supported by the border criterion and a finite exact rational identity over all thirteen weak-order patterns of each triple. Computations independently corroborate finite domains only. No external or independent review is asserted.
limitations: Exactly six positive binary run lengths; fixed-length distribution counts ordered sextuples, not necklaces. Extension to more runs is unproved. The 2004 primary article on border correlation could not be fully inspected; equivalent prior specialization is an originality risk.
title: Exact six-run unbordered-conjugate spectrum and its two-point limit
